[SWS_DM_01032] Handling of ’WIR’ bit without connected indicators
⌈
If there exists no DiagnosticConnectedIndicator configuration item for a Di-
agnosticEvent and therefore no indicators are assigned to an event and the status
for this event gets confirmed, the DM shall always keep the UDS DTC status bit "
kWarningIndicatorRequested" at value ’0’.
⌋
